name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Type to filter a list and pick one option.
a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox: the input has role="combobox" with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through options, Enter picks, Escape closes (and clears the typed text on a second press), Tab leaves.
Options are in a listbox with aria-selected; an empty result is announced as text.
